title: Compress and Convert Images in the Editor
summary: Automatically compress large images and convert WebP, HEIC, SVG, and more.
body_markdown:
Starting today, the Broadcast and Template editors automatically:


- compress large images
- convert unsupported formats


These improvements happen before upload. Drop, paste, or pick any image and the editor prepares it for email.


## Automatic compression


Email clients render most emails around 600px wide, so a full-resolution photo requires every recipient to download a larger image for no benefit.


- **Images over 1 MB** are resized to a maximum of 1500px wide and re-encoded.
- **GIFs are never compressed** , so animations stay intact.


Lighter images load faster for your recipients and keep your emails smaller.


## Format conversion


Email clients reliably support JPEG, PNG, and GIF. Other formats are not commonly supported, so they are now converted in the browser before upload:


- **SVG**
- **WebP** and **AVIF**
- **HEIC** and **HEIF** (photos from iPhone)
- **BMP** , **ICO** , and **TIFF** (TIFF only in browsers that can read it)


**Images with transparency become PNG** , so logos and cut-outs keep their transparent background. Everything else becomes JPEG. Converted images are also resized to a maximum of 1500px wide, whatever their file size.


## Conclusion


You no longer need to resize or convert images before adding them to an email.


If you have any questions,[view our documentation](https://resend.com/docs/dashboard/broadcasts/editor) or reach out to us and we'll be happy to help.
